content:
The presentation session of the 2nd GROW / HARVEST Call for Proposals of the METABUILDING Project, organised by PTPC, will take place next Thursday, March 3rd, at 9.30am.

This is the last opportunity for companies to submit an application to the METABUILDING project and this session aims to provide detailed information on this Call for Applications, as well as to clarify any doubts about it.

Registration for the event is free but compulsory ➡️ https://bit.ly/3oXKbMK.

We remind you that this Call for Proposals will open tomorrow, March 1st, and aims to stimulate cross-sector collaboration of SMEs in innovative projects, supporting with a sum of up to 60.000 euros per project.
